
[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- 06_stress_max_tasks.volt:0[/yellow bold]

Variable `isr1_count` is shared between critical task (isr1) and task (stress_report). The compiler will mark it `volatile` in generated C.


[cyan]Hint: For multi-word values, consider using atomic operations.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- 06_stress_max_tasks.volt:0[/yellow bold]

Variable `isr2_count` is shared between critical task (isr2) and task (stress_report). The compiler will mark it `volatile` in generated C.


[cyan]Hint: For multi-word values, consider using atomic operations.[/cyan]
